name: q
label: Search Query
help: Search terms. Supports operators like `site:`, `inurl:`, `intitle:`, `AND`, `OR`. Either Query or Knowledge Graph ID is required.

name: kgmid
label: Knowledge Graph ID
help: Knowledge Graph identifier. Format: `/m/` for locations (e.g., `/m/02_286` for New York) or `/g/` for entities (e.g., `/g/11f555cn8l` for TikTok). Either Query or Knowledge Graph ID is required.

name: device
label: Device
help: Device type for the search.

name: location
label: Location
help: Canonical location for the search (e.g., `New York` or `London`). Cannot be used with UULE.

name: uule
label: UULE
help: Google-encoded location. Cannot be used with Location parameter.

name: google_domain
label: Google Domain
help: Google domain for the search (e.g., `google.com`, `google.co.uk`).

name: gl
label: Country (gl)
help: Country code for the search (e.g., `us`, `uk`, `de`).

name: hl
label: Language (hl)
help: Interface language code (e.g., `en`, `es`, `fr`).

name: lr
label: Language Restriction (lr)
help: Restrict results to documents in specific languages. Format: `lang_xx` (e.g., `lang_en`). Multiple: `lang_it|lang_de`.

name: cr
label: Country Restriction (cr)
help: Restrict results to documents from specific countries. Based on TLD or server IP location.

name: nfpr
label: Disable Auto-Correction
help: Exclude auto-corrected spelling results.

name: filter
label: Content Filter
help: Enable or disable Duplicate Content and Host Crowding filters.

name: safe
label: SafeSearch
help: Filter adult content from results.

name: time_period
label: Time Period
help: Restrict results by date. Use custom dates with Time Period Min/Max.

name: time_period_min
label: Time Period Min
help: Start date for custom time period. Format: `MM/DD/YYYY`.

name: time_period_max
label: Time Period Max
help: End date for custom time period. Format: `MM/DD/YYYY`.

name: num
label: Results Per Page
help: Number of results per page.

name: page
label: Page
help: Page number of results to return.

name: optimization_strategy
label: Optimization Strategy
help: Controls how the search request is optimized.

name: zero_retention
label: Zero Data Retention
help: Disable all logging and storage. Enterprise only.
